q: What goes into the CBAM figure for urea and ammonia from Arzew?
title: Arzew urea and ammonia: the CBAM figure
short: Ammonia's figure is the gas burned and reformed to make it, plus power. Urea adds its own plant and takes in some CO2 from the ammonia plant, but under CBAM that CO2 is not subtracted. Ask for verified figures per tonne of each product.
audience: EU importers of Algerian ammonia and urea and traders buying from Arzew

ul: Reformer feed gas and fuel gas.
The ammonia it contains, as a precursor.
CO2 bound in urea is released when it is used, so it is not netted off.

p: Algeria has no carbon price to deduct.

senseible: Senseible keeps each site's fuel, power and production records together, so the embedded emissions you send an EU importer trace back to dated documents.

sources.label: 2006 IPCC Guidelines for National Greenhouse Gas Inventories
